title: Coherence of normalized Brown realization data
statement:
For any commutative ring O, element t, scheme W, supplied strict coefficient evaluation package P and realization data R, the section, localization and mate equations hold:

```lean
theorem etaleBrownLevelRealizationCoherence_exists
    (O : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing O] (t : O) (W : Scheme.{u})
    (P : StrictEtaleEvaluation W O t)
    (R : StrictEtaleBrownRealizationData O t W P) :
    StrictEtaleBrownRealizationCoherence O t W P R
```

proof.text: Check the section equation on the constant-ring sheafification unit, the representative equation after exact localization, and the scalar equation by the inverse mate law.
